title: Design the diagram skill suite and repository layout
description: Phase 3a: propose the suite (skills, shared engine, fidelity mechanism, validation gate, level pairing, repo layout) as a lore Spec with two options, recommendation first; get the owner's approval before any skill is written or anything committed.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A lore Spec describes both suite options, recommendation first, with the trade-off for each
The owner has chosen a suite option and it is recorded in the Spec and an ADR
The repository layout is written down and approved by the owner

implementationNotes: Owner chose Option B (six skills) 2026-10-05 -> ADR-0002, DEC-2. Owner approved the repository layout (engine inside diagram-review/scripts) 2026-10-05.
